statement: The cited all-finite centralizer proofs contain an unverified closure-intersection step. A noncircular induction from prime-power normalizer and congruence inputs proves the solvable comparison. For geometric A5 on a punctured sphere, the completed and discrete centralizers have the same puncture-permutation image: exceptional orbits are fixed pointwise and m free orbits have image A5^m semidirect S_m. The pure completion equality at all refinements remains unproved here.

notes: No counterexample to the source theorem is asserted. Each cusp is detected by a four-point twist character with multiplier one or two. The A5 centralizer equality remains unproved. All six labels, rational coordinates, the extra involution, the algebraic icosahedral basepoint, and the transport path to F9 are displayed. Formula F.7.17 identifies the residual A5 centralizer exactly as the fixed intersection under that based involution. The matrix certificate passed 180 generator products and 720 vertex labels. The actual based covering and cusp labels identify it with the given twelve-vertex action. Both normalization inverses are proved. The remaining completed geometric centralizer equals the intersection of this GT0^1 image with the completed pure geometric subgroup. The220 actual three-cusp filling detectors reduce to five kernels by exact A5 equivariance, with orbit sizes20,60,60,60,20. Their joint injectivity and the geometric intersection remain unresolved. The actual detector remains the outer class of p_i eta_f^H iota0|K. The common section is a proper full self-embedding of K despite inducing automorphisms on every free pro-p quotient; its trivial A5 image explicitly detects the missing surjectivity. Faithfulness of the outer detector family remains unresolved. F7.49-F7.57 prove the full unit boundary generation test for the modular orbifold, identify GT0^1 with the exact solution space S modulo g->d^{5t}g, and give the unique first-detector kernel slice S intersect ker(p0). A unique H cone conjugator supplies all five based filling equations. The 60-coset presentation, 95 exact Tietze eliminations, all five inverse full-basis maps, and exact cusp words were executed and independently rerun. Four C3-stable detectors use the same source word R(g). The simultaneous full equations and their intersection with the actual completed geometric subgroup remain unresolved. F16 constructs a full Zhat inside the correcting centralizer killed by every proper labelled forgetting and disjoint from the original curve image. Thus the pullback membership test using all proper forgetting images is strictly larger even after centralization. The original source-equalizer obligation remains unresolved. F17 proves the literal ordered drilling needs sixteen new source punctures and cannot factor through the original source map. F18 proves the unique canonical centralizing branch lift for every actual residual element, using the full two-class cocycle comparison and literal V4 stabilizer labels. The remaining rational-source membership is the displayed K+ right-coset test; neither its universal vanishing nor triviality of the residual is asserted. The drilled image K+ semidirect L and full two-track pullback D+ semidirect L have the same explicitly split quotient. No K+=D+ or residual-triviality conclusion is asserted. The 82 invariant A5 quotients, all 3321 paired quotients, and six noncentral 60*2^121 quotients have transitive source actions; K+ and D+ have equal full images under these specified maps for every coefficient prime. The full K+ membership and residual equalizer remain open. F21 proves closed normal_D+(K+)=D+ and onto maps from K+ to D+ abelianization and its maximal pronilpotent quotient. It retains all eight actual divisor labels and original source whiskers. K+=D+ and the original residual membership remain unresolved. The actual marginal images therefore agree for every scalar field of order nine, including larger original coefficient fields. General trace rank, full marginal equality and the original interaction/source equalizer remain unresolved. F27 proves all-field affine marginal image equality on the precise two-parameter product-one locus by an essential-line Laurent determinant and actual Vandermonde evaluations. F28 proves the larger three-parameter locus via an explicit two-dimensional invariant subspace and four quotient coordinates: exact source scalars exclude all cross-factor minimal-submodule intertwiners, and F24 individual injection gives summed rank6m+1. Both retain the original scalar character, original based sign maps and larger coefficient fields. The general character locus, full marginal equality, interaction source image and original residual equation remain unresolved. F29 proves all finite affine marginal images on the exact four-parameter product-one locus (r,s,t,u,1,1,(rstu)^-1), with summed restriction rank6m+1. Four actual principal charts retain all sources; complete cross-factor submodule comparisons, an exceptional residual -2 and an actual essential-line Vandermonde inverse prove the trace kernel. The exact trace and based sign maps include both signs and larger original fields. The general character locus, full marginal equality, interaction image and original residual equation remain unresolved.
